title: Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy Debut
message: Congratulations to Ishant Bhardwaj on his Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy debut against Vadodara. A proud moment for our academy as he continues to move forward in his cricketing journey.
imageAlt: Ishant Bhardwaj in action during his Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy debut

title: Man of the Match Award
message: Congratulations, Ishant Bharadwaj! Your performance was outstanding, and earning the Man of the Match award in the very second match you played in SMAT.
imageAlt: Ishant Bharadwaj receiving Man of the Match award in SMAT
